students.all: SELECT * FROM students ORDER BY id
students.insert: INSERT INTO students(display_name, class_label, password_hash) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
students.passwordHash: SELECT password_hash FROM students WHERE id = $1
students.rename: UPDATE students SET display_name = $2 WHERE id = $1
students.renameWithClass: UPDATE students SET display_name = $2, class_label = $3 WHERE id = $1
students.setPassword: UPDATE students SET password_hash = $2 WHERE id = $1
students.moveClass: UPDATE students SET class_label = $2 WHERE class_label = $1
students.classLabels: SELECT DISTINCT class_label FROM students WHERE class_label IS NOT NULL ORDER BY class_label
progress.forStudent: SELECT * FROM progress WHERE student_id = $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC
progress.upsert: INSERT INTO progress(student_id, topic_id, state) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT(student_id, topic_id) DO UPDATE SET state = CASE WHEN progress.state = 'completed' THEN 'completed' ELSE excluded.state END, updated_at = datetime('now')
progress.all: SELECT p.student_id, p.topic_id, p.state, p.updated_at, s.display_name, s.class_label FROM progress p JOIN students s ON s.id = p.student_id ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC
progress.recent: SELECT p.student_id, s.display_name, s.class_label, p.topic_id, p.state, p.updated_at FROM progress p JOIN students s ON s.id = p.student_id ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT $1
adminPin.get: SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'admin_pin'
adminPin.set: INSERT INTO settings(key, value) VALUES ('admin_pin', $1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value
